learning_outcomes.text: Build formulas using cell references, operators and the correct order of evaluation
Apply logical functions (IF, AND, OR, nested conditions) to make decisions
Look up and retrieve data with VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX and MATCH
Aggregate and summarise data with SUM, COUNT, AVERAGE and conditional variants
Handle errors and build auditable, maintainable formulas

integrative_case: A sales analyst inherits a workbook of raw order rows and a product price list; build formulas that classify orders, look up list prices, total revenue by region with conditional aggregation, and trap errors so the summary stays clean when data changes.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
